module_summary: PS/2-style 3-byte packet framer: a one-hot FSM syncs on bytes with bit3 set, a 24-bit byte shift window captures the packet, and done qualifies the output.

anchors.name: oh
anchors.why: One-hot state (hunt, byte2, byte3, done) sequencing packet reception

anchors.name: win
anchors.why: 24-bit shift window holding last three received bytes

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: Byte stream input shifted into window; bit3 marks packet start

anchors.name: out_bytes
anchors.why: Assembled 3-byte packet output, valid only when done

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse from FIN state qualifying out_bytes

anchors.name: go_mid
anchors.why: Packet-start condition: marker bit seen in HUNT or FIN state

groups.name: Packet FSM
groups.description: One-hot framer FSM detecting start byte and counting three bytes

groups.name: Byte window
groups.description: Shift window of the last three input bytes driving out_bytes
